# FDGA052

> DO use PascalCasing for namespace, type, and member names, except for internal and private fields.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.2 Naming Conventions.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE1006
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test suggestion
- Status: verified

IDE1006 checks the first letter only.

## Options

```ini
dotnet_naming_rule.fdga052_types_and_members.symbols = fdg_types_and_members
dotnet_naming_rule.fdga052_types_and_members.style = fdg_pascal_case
dotnet_naming_symbols.fdg_types_and_members.applicable_kinds = namespace, class, struct, interface, enum, delegate, property, method, event, type_parameter
dotnet_naming_symbols.fdg_types_and_members.applicable_accessibilities = *
dotnet_naming_rule.fdga052_visible_fields.symbols = fdg_visible_fields
dotnet_naming_rule.fdga052_visible_fields.style = fdg_pascal_case
dotnet_naming_symbols.fdg_visible_fields.applicable_kinds = field
dotnet_naming_symbols.fdg_visible_fields.applicable_accessibilities = public, protected, protected_internal
dotnet_naming_style.fdg_pascal_case.capitalization = pascal_case
```
